action_items: OPTIONAL: The problem statement quoted Inventory value as ₹6,700; the correct computed value is ₹11,410 (50*100+15*98+40*100+10*94). UI is right, the statement was a math typo — no code change needed.

OPTIONAL: A React hydration warning appears in the console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' on some ERP pages (probably in the ERP nav or a select in Reports). Non-blocking but worth cleaning up.
critical_code_review_comments: erp.js — inventorySummary() ignores its `vendorId` arg when called from financialHealth() (it's invoked as `(await inventorySummary()).inventoryValue_paise` without vendorId, causing local additions from other vendors to leak via the `mergeWithLocal(undefined, …)` path since key becomes `${NS}.anon.products`). Minor because there are no local products in the target account, but should be passed the current vendorId.

erp.js gstAssistant() / gstDashboard() / etc. drop the `ownerPassword` argument silently — pages that pass it will still work because backend ignores 428 here, but the function signatures should either accept and forward the header or remove the arg to avoid confusion.

financialHealth() uses `inr(d.turnover)` and `inr(d.profit)` — good — but `highestSalesMonth`/`lowestSalesMonth` will both be the same month when there is only one bucket. Cosmetic; consider hiding when series length is 1.
React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' fires from a <select> containing markup — search rendered pages for `<option>` with nested JSX.
